item.title: Trump says D.C. arch would serve as military complex with snipers and drones
item.description: President Trump says military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C. to protect national security.

item.title: Germany's Merz vows to continue reforms after state election defeat
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz suffered a major electoral setback in two state elections, with his center-right party losing ground to the far-right.

item.title: Empty New Orleans building becomes free store and roller rink
item.description: In the Lower Ninth Ward, a graffiti-covered former Family Dollar appears abandoned, but inside it holds clothing, home goods and more.

item.title: Judge orders Fox to turn over documents in shareholders' case
item.description: Fox Corp. has been ordered to release hundreds of documents that may reveal how founder Rupert Murdoch managed major scandals at his media companies.
